mini_ssh_alias: mac-mini@192.168.1.135 (same LAN; MacBook opens the tunnel, no Tailscale)
worker_token_procedure: The Mac mini operator generates MOA_WORKER_TOKEN server-side and hands it over through a separate safe channel (NOT chat, NOT this file). On the MacBook store it with mode 600, e.g. ~/.config/moa/worker-token (file containing the token only), or the login Keychain, and export MOA_WORKER_TOKEN at tunnel time.
relay_runtime_note: Relay runs from an internal copy at ~/.config/moa/moa-mini-relay.py (launchd cannot read the external SSD). Sync it from scripts/moa-mini-relay.py after edits.
